high_level_description: The image is a screenshot of an article from a website titled "Heat Vision." The article is categorized under "Movies" and specifically under "Movie News." The headline reads: "'Joker: Folie à Deux' Flails at Box Office After Receiving an Unprecedented D CinemaScore." The article discusses Todd Phillips' movie starring Joaquin Phoenix and Lady Gaga, which is described as the first Hollywood comic book picture to receive a failing grade from audiences. It mentions that the film may only open in the mid-$40 million range.
